About us

News that helps you see the wider picture.

News becomes useful when it helps us understand what is changing and why it matters. Herald News Today is a general news website built around that purpose, bringing together stories that connect major developments with everyday concerns.

A broader view

Events rarely fit neatly into one category.

Herald News Today explores these connections through coverage of current events, business, technology, health, lifestyle, and world affairs — looking beyond an individual headline to the circumstances, people, and decisions behind it.

TechnologyA new technology can reshape workplaces.
EconomyAn economic decision can affect household budgets.
CommunityA local issue can become part of a national conversation.
Our purpose

Stay informed without the news getting harder to follow.

Whether you are following a familiar topic or encountering an issue for the first time, we want our content to offer a clear starting point for understanding it.

When a story breaks, we answer:
01What happened?
02What led to it?
03Who could be affected?
04What remains uncertain?
Our standards

The standards we aim to uphold

Useful coverage depends on careful attention to facts, language, and context. Our editorial approach is guided by these principles.

These principles shape the kind of publication we want Herald News Today to be: readable, thoughtful, and attentive to the trust readers place in news.

Our readers

Created for curious readers.

Our audience includes people who follow the news closely and those who simply want to understand a story affecting their lives. You do not need specialist knowledge to engage with the subjects we cover.

We write for readers who ask questions, seek context, and want enough information to form their own views. Their curiosity gives our coverage its direction.

Keep exploring

Every day brings developments worth examining.

Herald News Today offers a place to explore both new developments and familiar issues worth revisiting, with an emphasis on clear explanations and meaningful context. Browse our latest stories, discover a different perspective, and stay connected to the events shaping the world around you.
